stem: Brightwell Media serves the same set of product images and videos to a worldwide audience thousands of times a day and wants to stop paying full Regional data-transfer rates for every repeat view of the same file.

choices.text: Add AWS Global Accelerator in front of the origin bucket
Create additional S3 buckets in more Regions for users to pick from
Put Amazon CloudFront in front of the S3 bucket
Increase the EC2 fleet size serving the files behind an Application Load Balancer

rationale: CloudFront caches the images and videos at edge locations, so repeat views are served without generating a fresh Regional data-transfer charge each time. Global Accelerator improves routing performance for TCP/UDP endpoints, it does not cache HTTP objects. Additional Regional buckets require users to pick one themselves and still charge full Regional rates per fetch. Adding EC2 capacity behind a load balancer increases compute cost without reducing data-transfer cost or caching anything.
